From: Fenech, Anthony 
Sent: Monday, December 16, 2019 8:24 PM
To: Crawford, Kirkland <kcrawford@freepress.com>; Ford, Ryan <rford@freepress.com>
Subject: Retiring Lou's No. 1

The Tigers are apparently announcing tomorrow that they are retiring Lou's uniform No. 1. Last I heard, it's going to be announced at 10 a.m., so I'll send something in a bit that can be ready to post when it's announced. I believe he'd be just the second Tiger to have his number retired without being in the Hall of Fame (Willie Horton).
